name: careerlog net first-N-season and best-season columns
description: league_format_player_careerlogs carries a net counterpart for every first-N-season and best-season aggregate, and until these fields were registered nothing could read them. This fixture pins the emitted SQL for four of the seven net columns alongside an earned sibling. league_format_player_careerlogs is one row per (pid, league_format_id) and pins no period sentinel, so every column of one format legitimately shares a single join -- the fixture pins that shared alias, which is the correct shape here rather than the collision shape league_format_player_projection_values had. It fails at any revision where the net fields are unregistered. The league_format_id param is explicit so nothing here is clock-derived.
expected_query: select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."points_added_net_first_season" AS "points_added_net_first_season_from_careerlogs_0", "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."points_added_net_first_three_seasons" AS "points_added_net_first_three_seasons_from_careerlogs_0", "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."best_season_points_added_net_per_game" AS "best_season_points_added_net_per_game_from_careerlogs_0", "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."points_added_earned_first_season" AS "points_added_earned_first_season_from_careerlogs_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" left join "league_format_player_careerlogs" as "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7" on "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."league_format_id" = 'genesis_10_team' group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."points_added_net_first_season", "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."points_added_net_first_three_seasons", "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."best_season_points_added_net_per_game", "t8da47e69a2555b893c6fda004c7987f7"."points_added_earned_first_season", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
